name: Maverick Hunter - Axl
desc: You can discard 1 "Maverick Boost" card; Special Summon this card from your hand or GY. If this card is Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; its ATK and DEF become half its current ATK and DEF. You can only use each effect of "Maverick Hunter - Axl" once per turn.
strings: Halve ATK and DEF of 1 opponent's monster
